column18: One-shot GLT: +1.32-45.62% weight sparsity, +7.49-22.71% graph sparsity, 1.7-44x speedup over IMP, 95.3-98.6% MAC savings.
SNN uses 28% of the energy of a comparable ANN model; seizure prediction on two public EEG datasets.
Federated SNN co-design with NSGA-II multi-objective search over accuracy, energy and communication; no ANN comparison.
LTH-based structured pruning in federated learning with per-client pruning rates; claims lower computation and communication overhead, no figures.
Akida AKD1000 vs Xeon CPU: over 97% power reduction, 1.3x latency increase; EEG braking intent accuracy at least 90%.
Sparse masks plus parameter signs let randomly initialized networks reach low error barriers; no efficiency figures.
FireFly-S FPGA: weight sparsity 85-95%, 4-bit; 10,047 FPS/W MNIST, 3,683 DVS-Gesture, 2,327 CIFAR-10.
Mott memristor neuristor device; device-based sparse network simulations, no ANN comparison or pruning method.
CNN-to-SNN pipeline for skin lesion classification on Akida NPU; no efficiency or accuracy figures reported.
CNN-to-SNN conversion for depression detection; SNN matches CNN accuracy 82.5% and F1 0.8254; no efficiency metric.
Lossy spike compression cuts spike data size by up to 31.50% with under 1.16% accuracy drop; SNN-only, no pruning.
FSTA attention module suppresses redundant spikes and significantly reduces SNN firing rate; no figures in abstract.
ANN-SNN conversion with temporal bias correction improves accuracy on CIFAR-10/100 and ImageNet; no efficiency metric.
Loihi energy/inference 4.30% of event spike tensor method on Jetson Orin NX; 1.64% of event frame method on Loihi.
Theoretical energy model compares SNN with ANN baselines for robotic arm reaching and grasping; no figures in abstract.
Fully spiking actor network; outperforms state of the art on control tasks; theoretical energy estimate without stated ANN comparator.
Fully spiking frame-event tracker claims lower power than existing methods; no ANN comparator or figures given.
Spiking CNN energy savings ten times smaller than conventional NN model for pulsed eddy current corrosion detection.
BERT sentiment: lossless 70% head reduction, up to 90% with 1% F1 loss; inference time improved up to 47.2%.
LTH-inspired sub-network activation for GNN multi-view learning improves generalization at minimal inference cost; no efficiency figures.
Structured gradient-flow pruning in iterative lottery-ticket framework; outperforms magnitude and gradient pruning baselines at high sparsity; inference speedups unquantified.
Quaternion GNN with one-fourth parameters; graph lottery tickets cut trainable parameters further; no energy or operation figures.
Spiking neurons learn sparse attention coefficients for GATs, giving edge-sparsified graphs; efficiency claimed without figures.
Dynamic priority-aware gradient sparsification for SNN online learning (DECOLLE, ETLP, OTTT); efficiency gains claimed, no figures.
Event-graph ANN on SoC FPGA: SHD accuracy 92.3% quantised, +19.3% and +4.5% over FPGA SNNs; fewer resources, lower latency.
